summary: Wide main menu and loading screen from the new art (full in wide, centre crop in letterbox)
author: pm
body:
Rebuild the main menu from the user's wide art. Source sheet: working/classic_ui/hd/main_menu.png (1920x1300, the user's; read-only, also main_menu.psd / main_menu_no_text.png). It holds:
- the 1920x1080 background at (0,0), with logo and title baked in;
- a hover plate, 296x39, translucent white (alpha about 51), at (16,1100);
- labels for Log In (x 337-447), New Account (476-721) and Exit (750-821), as black at y 1108 and gold at y 1148, each 24 px tall.

User, 2026-11-25: picked layout A ("A, under the title"). Mockup: .claude/scratch/coordinator/main_menu_wide/menu_a.png, script compose.py beside it.

Layout A, in 1920x1080 art pixels:
- buttons stacked and centred on x 1408 (the centre of "THE HELDENIAN PROJECT"), at y 360, 416 and 472 (56 px apart);
- normal item: the black label as a 2 px drop shadow, then the label in bone (226, 214, 192);
- hover: the plate centred behind the label, then the shadow, then the gold label.

These are guesses the user may correct: black as the shadow, the plate as the hover highlight, and the bone colour for the normal state (not in the sheet).

Today: screen_main_menu.cpp draws InterfaceNdMainMenu frame 0 at (0,0) in the 640x480 view and puts three cc::button controls at x 465 (y 238/276/315, 164x22), as of 2026-11-25.

Open questions for the plan:
- how a 16:9 backdrop should fit 4:3, letterbox and stretch outputs (Helbreath-SDL uses a centre-cropped cover fit for front-end backdrops);
- where the button hit areas sit at each aspect;
- how the art gets into staged/ (a sprite folder vs a single image) and at what resolution;
- whether the version text and copyright lines stay.

**Done when:** the main menu shows the wide art with layout A at 16:9 and a sensible crop at 4:3; hover, click and keyboard focus work through CControls; both builds are clean; screenshots at 4:3 and 16:9 are attached.

Source: user in chat, 2026-11-25.

**Scope update, 2026-11-25 (user):**
- "These are some widescreen additions - if the resolution is in wide screen we should offer the full view. If we are in letterbox we should chop off the sides and only present the center"
- "These should replace the existing"

Assets, all in working/classic_ui/hd (the user's folder; read-only, copy into staged/):
- main_menu_no_text.png (1920x1300): replaces the main menu backdrop, intermediate_screens sprite 1 frame 0 (800x600).
- loading_screen.png (1924x1128): the 1920x1080-ish backdrop plus "Loading Data ..." labels in white and gold below it. Replaces the loading screen sprite (screen_loading.cpp:38).
- interface.pak-001_x4.png goes to HH-0083 (the label sheet).

Rules:
- Wide output (stretch / widescreen) shows the full 16:9 image.
- Letterbox shows the centre 4:3 crop (1440x1080 of 1920x1080).
- Layout A's buttons at art x 1408 +-148 stay inside the crop (x 240-1680), measured.

Researcher findings, 2026-11-25 (read-only, Sonnet):
- The logical UI is 800x600, not 640x480 (resolution_config.h:14).
- No call exposes the visible window extent in UI units. Add IRenderer::get_screen_extent() from current_screen_mapping().view (sfml_renderer.cpp:391).
- Draw the backdrop with create_texture_from_file(smooth) and draw_texture_region (the minimap and kits use the same path).
- Re-lay-out the cc::buttons each frame with set_local_bounds; mouse mapping already allows out-of-range UI units in stretch (sfml_window.cpp:860).
